_note: Run: .venvs/mar/bin/python bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/mar-pretrain-device.json --python /home/yoshihiro_fukuhara_caddi_jp/10YearVisualSSL/.venvs/mar/bin/python (an interpreter with this method's cu130 lock and a CUDA device). Proves the device guard added during the port is not vacuous. The upstream MAR forward built tensors with a hard-coded .cuda() (sample_orders, forward_mae_encoder), so it could not run without a GPU; the pinned fork makes it device-agnostic and resolve_device decides the device from the config. Honouring device: cpu on a GPU machine, and refusing device: cuda on a GPU-less one, are the behaviours these mutations must break. See docs/GPU.md section 4.
